name: app/side-nav
title: SideNav
summary: An app's navigation, dense like a product console: quiet group labels, one 32px row per item (44px on touch) with an icon and the label, a badge, nested items under a disclosure, and the current item filled with a brand-coloured indicator. Descriptions are tooltips and accessible descriptions, never printed.

props.name: groups
props.description: Grouped items (`@bundu/ui/app/nav`; `groupNav` builds them from flat registrations). Takes precedence over `items`.

props.name: items
props.description: A flat list, as in 0.3; rendered as one unlabelled group.

props.name: current
props.description: The current href. Omitted: the longest href the page path is at or below (`currentHref`).

props.name: idPrefix
props.description: Prefix for tooltip and group-label ids; unique per page.

behaviour: Exactly one item, the current one, carries aria-current="page" and the filled row with a 2px `--primary` indicator.
An item with children is a <details> disclosure, open when it contains the current page. A parent that is a page itself is listed first among its children ("Overview", or `overviewLabel`).
An item's `description` (0.3: `summary`) is a role="tooltip" element and the link's aria-describedby; it is shown on hover and keyboard focus from 64rem, and never printed in the list.
In AppShell's collapsed rail each tooltip also shows the label, and a nested group is replaced by one rail link to its first item.

default.description: Two groups, an icon, a badge, a description and a nested branch containing the current page.

roles: list (each group's <ul role="list">, named by its group label)
keyboard: Tab moves through every link and disclosure summary in order.
Enter or Space on a summary opens or closes its group.
Escape hides a visible tooltip (AppShell's script).
focus: Every row shows a 2px `--ring` focus ring (focus-visible).
A tooltip shows on keyboard focus as well as hover.
aria: aria-describedby from a link to its description.
aria-labelledby from each group list to its label.

theming.brandOverlay: The current item's indicator is AppShell's `--app-accent` (the brand fill), else `--primary` (Nyuchi gold, Mukoko tanzanite, …) and the focus ring is `--ring`. Rows, spacing and type are identical in every brand.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: Fills the sidebar's width; labels truncate rather than wrap.
Tooltips are drawn from 64rem only; on phones the description is still the accessible description.
contract:
contract
  slot is "side-nav"
  label is "Sections"
  a "Home" min_height 32
  when default shows a "News"
  when default shows summary "Content"
  when flat shows a "B"
end

checks.say: Exactly one link is the current page.
The current link is the nested News item.
A branch holding the current page is open.
A description is a tooltip, wired by aria-describedby.
Group lists are named by their labels.
A badge is text beside the label.
